package nats

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"time"

	"github.com/nats-io/nats.go"
	"go.uber.org/zap"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain"
)

const (
	TaskAnswerEventsStream        = "TASKANSWER_EVENTS"
	LearningActionConsumerQueue   = "ms-teacher-learning-action-closed"
	LearningActionConsumerDurable = "ms-teacher-learning-action-closed-v1"
)

type learningActionEnvelope struct {
	EventID       string                   `json:"event_id"`
	EventType     string                   `json:"event_type"`
	CorrelationID string                   `json:"correlation_id"`
	CausationID   string                   `json:"causation_id"`
	StudentID     string                   `json:"student_id"`
	OccurredAt    time.Time                `json:"occurred_at"`
	SchemaVersion int                      `json:"schema_version"`
	Data          learningActionClosedData `json:"data"`
}

type learningActionClosedData struct {
	LearningActionID string                     `json:"learning_action_id"`
	ContextType      domain.LearningContextType `json:"context_type"`
	ContextID        string                     `json:"context_id"`
	LearningTargets  []domain.LearningTargetRef `json:"learning_targets"`
}

// DecodeLearningActionClosed validates the exact student-owned v1 envelope.
func DecodeLearningActionClosed(payload []byte) (domain.LearningActionClosed, error) {
	var envelope learningActionEnvelope
	if err := decodeStrictJSON(payload, &envelope); err != nil {
		return domain.LearningActionClosed{}, fmt.Errorf("decode learning action closure: %w", err)
	}
	if envelope.EventType != domain.SubjectLearningActionClosed {
		return domain.LearningActionClosed{}, errors.New("unsupported learning action event type")
	}
	if envelope.SchemaVersion != domain.LearningActionClosedSchemaVersion {
		return domain.LearningActionClosed{}, errors.New("unsupported learning action schema version")
	}
	return domain.NewLearningActionClosed(domain.LearningActionClosed{
		EventID:          envelope.EventID,
		StudentID:        envelope.StudentID,
		CorrelationID:    envelope.CorrelationID,
		CausationID:      envelope.CausationID,
		LearningActionID: envelope.Data.LearningActionID,
		ContextType:      envelope.Data.ContextType,
		ContextID:        envelope.Data.ContextID,
		LearningTargets:  envelope.Data.LearningTargets,
		OccurredAt:       envelope.OccurredAt,
	})
}

func decodeStrictJSON(payload []byte, target any) error {
	decoder := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(payload))
	decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
	if err := decoder.Decode(target); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := decoder.Decode(&struct{}{}); !errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
		if err == nil {
			return errors.New("multiple JSON values")
		}
		return err
	}
	return nil
}

// LearningActionClosedSubscriber consumes the student trigger with durable,
// explicit acknowledgement. Invalid contracts terminate; transient failures retry.
type LearningActionClosedSubscriber struct {
	Conn       *nats.Conn
	Handler    func(context.Context, domain.LearningActionClosed) (bool, error)
	Logger     *zap.Logger
	AckWait    time.Duration
	RetryDelay time.Duration
}

// Subscribe installs the durable queue consumer and flushes the registration.
func (subscriber LearningActionClosedSubscriber) Subscribe(ctx context.Context) error {
	if subscriber.Conn == nil {
		return errors.New("learning action subscriber connection is required")
	}
	if subscriber.Handler == nil {
		return errors.New("learning action subscriber handler is required")
	}
	logger := subscriber.Logger
	if logger == nil {
		logger = zap.NewNop()
	}
	ackWait := subscriber.AckWait
	if ackWait <= 0 {
		ackWait = 30 * time.Second
	}
	retryDelay := subscriber.RetryDelay
	if retryDelay <= 0 {
		retryDelay = 5 * time.Second
	}
	jetStream, err := subscriber.Conn.JetStream()
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	_, err = jetStream.QueueSubscribe(
		domain.SubjectLearningActionClosed,
		LearningActionConsumerQueue,
		func(message *nats.Msg) {
			closure, decodeErr := DecodeLearningActionClosed(message.Data)
			if decodeErr != nil {
				logger.Warn("terminate invalid learning action closure", zap.Error(decodeErr))
				if termErr := message.Term(); termErr != nil {
					logger.Warn("terminate learning action closure", zap.Error(termErr))
				}
				return
			}
			processed, handleErr := subscriber.Handler(ctx, closure)
			if handleErr != nil {
				logger.Warn("retry learning action closure", zap.String("event_id", closure.EventID), zap.Error(handleErr))
				if nakErr := message.NakWithDelay(retryDelay); nakErr != nil {
					logger.Warn("nak learning action closure", zap.String("event_id", closure.EventID), zap.Error(nakErr))
				}
				return
			}
			if ackErr := message.AckSync(); ackErr != nil {
				logger.Warn("ack learning action closure", zap.String("event_id", closure.EventID), zap.Error(ackErr))
				return
			}
			logger.Debug("learning action closure handled", zap.String("event_id", closure.EventID), zap.Bool("processed", processed))
		},
		nats.BindStream(TaskAnswerEventsStream),
		nats.Durable(LearningActionConsumerDurable),
		nats.ManualAck(),
		nats.AckExplicit(),
		nats.DeliverAll(),
		nats.AckWait(ackWait),
	)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return subscriber.Conn.FlushTimeout(5 * time.Second)
}
